mapper.select: select doc::text as doc from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select coalesce(sum(calls), 0)::bigint as calls, coalesce(sum(tin + tout), 0)::bigint as tok from ai_usage where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = #{day}::date

select coalesce((select sum(amount) from led_receipt where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'paid' and (paid_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date), 0)::bigint - coalesce((select sum(amount) from led_refund where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'done' and (coalesce(done_at, at) at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date = #{day}::date), 0)::bigint
select doc::text as doc from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid} for update
select case when created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes' then 1 else 0 end from sessions where id = #{sid}
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = #{doc}::jsonb, rev = rev + 1, bytes = #{bytes}, updated_at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid}
